item.title: Snow warning issued for Cavan and Monaghan
item.description: A Status Yellow Snow and Ice warning has been issued for Cavan, Donegal, Monaghan, Connacht and Louth. Wintry showers with some snow accumulations are expected. Sharp or severe frost and ice is also forecasted. Advertisement Hazardous Travel conditions and poor visibility in the region is expecteed. The warning is from 18:00 Sat 03/01 to 11:00 and run until Sun evening 04/01

item.title: Local housing demand outweighing supply
item.description: House prices in the Northern Sound region continue to rise. That's according to the latest Daft.ie report which shows market prices in counties Cavan and Monaghan each saw an increase in the last 3 months of 2025. In Monaghan, the average price for a three-bed semi-d has risen by 22.2 per cent to over 272 thousand euro while County Cavan saw a rise of 5.3 per cent with prices there 227 thousand euro. item.title: Over 44,000 NCT failures locally in 2025
item.description: Over 44,000 cars failed the NCT in the Shannonside Northern Sound region across 2025. The statistics were made available on the official NCT website. Just over 79,000 tests were carried out in Carrick-on-Shannon, Castlerea, Cavan, Longford and Monaghan between January and December. Advertisement Castlerea had the highest pass rate in the region at 45.64 per cent. That was followed by Carrick-on-Shannon at 44.72 per cent and Monaghan at 42.16 per cent. item.title: Cavan farmer savours sausage success
item.description: A Co Cavan producer has been crowned winner of Grow with ALDI 2025, with products hitting shelves nationwide from early next month. Barry John Sausages is set to launch in all 166 ALDI stores nationwide from January 8th. The announcement comes as ALDI opens applications for the 2026 programme. item.title: Calls for greater supports to protect farmers
item.description: A Cavan farmer believes lack of free time can lead to farmers neglecting their own health. Young farmer and social media creator Sophie Bell says long hours often mean farmers skip doctor's visits, exercise and time with friends. She warns the pressure of balancing everything on the farm can push younger people away from the industry, especially during tougher winter months. item.title: €60,000 raised in memory of Ballinagh man who died in Australia
item.description: A Go-Fund-Me page set up in memory of Sean Keaney has amassed over £50,000 sterling in the first eight hours of the page been in operation. Tara GFC have set up the page in memory of Sean Keaney, a beloved senior player with Tara GFC, to support The Kevin Bell Repatriation Trust; a charity dedicated to easing the financial burden for bereaved families repatriating loved ones who have tragically passed away abroad back to Ireland Every penny raised will go directly to this incredible cause. item.title: Popular Castleblayney family business set to permanently close
item.description: A long running family owned builders providers and hardware merchants in Castleblayney are set to close its doors for one last time. RB Coogan announced on social media today that they have decided to close the business. Advertisement The permanent planned closure of the shop will take place on the 28th February due to the sale of the premises. In the online post the said they would like to express their gratitude for the business and support throughout the many years.

item.title: Snow warning locally extended until Monday morning
item.description: A spell of wintry weather is set to grip the country this weekend, with a series of Status Yellow warnings coming into effect. A snow and ice warning applies to Cavan, Monaghan, Donegal, Connacht and Louth from 6pm tomorrow and will remain in place until 11am on Monday morning. Temperatures are forecast to drop to as low as minus four degrees, bringing widespread frost and ice leaving for significant frosty and icy conditions across the country.
